artifacts.synopsis: Mr. Goggan was excommunicated by a Missouri Presbytery judicial commission after a trial on charges of bearing false witness, perpetuating a faction, and other offenses. The SJC denied his appeal, finding he failed to demonstrate sufficient reason to sustain any of the alleged errors.
